name: Grapevine Leafroll Disease
symptoms: Leaves roll downward from the edges Red or purple leaves in red varieties Yellow leaves in white varieties Green veins remain visible Delayed fruit ripening Reduced sugar content in grapes
description: A viral disease of grapevines that reduces yield and fruit quality. It causes leaf rolling, discoloration, and poor grape ripening.
management: Remove infected vines Control mealybugs and scale insects Use certified virus-free planting material Monitor vineyards regularly
prevention: Plant certified virus-free vines Control insect vectors early Remove infected vines quickly Sanitize propagation materials
